sme_green_loan.esg_requirement: Submission of verified Green Energy or Carbon Reduction roadmap required within 90 days.
strict_prohibitions: Never waive the 2-year registered business operation threshold

cross_border_remittance.data_privacy_rule: Sovereignty strict lock: Plaintext NRIC, NIK, Aadhaar or bank account numbers strictly forbidden across borders.

high_yield_business_deposit.insured_scheme: SDIC Singapore (up to 100k SGD) / LPS Indonesia (up to 2B IDR)

underwriting_principles: Evaluation strictly based on real transaction volume and cashflow velocity.
MAS FEAT Fairness Principle: Prohibits penalizing credit limit or interest rate based on gender, marital status, or rural geographic postal code.
Algorithmic explainability disclosure must be supplied upon customer request.

mas_feat.name: Monetary Authority of Singapore (MAS) FEAT & Veritas Framework

pillars.fairness: Individuals or groups must not be systematically disadvantaged on basis of protected attributes (gender, race, disability, postal tier).
pillars.ethics: AI systems must align with bank core values; deceptive sales urgency or coercive dark patterns strictly prohibited.
pillars.accountability: Internal governance, human-in-the-loop audit logs, and clear ownership of AI decisions.
pillars.transparency: Explicit disclosure of AI identity, clear explanation of product terms and limitations, no concealed APR terms.

indonesia_gr_71_2019.name: Indonesia Government Regulation No. 71 of 2019 (PSTE) & PDP Law No. 27/2022
indonesia_gr_71_2019.rule: Mandatory data residency & sovereignty for public and critical financial electronic systems. NIK and national identifiers must remain strictly within national border data airlocks unless bilateral safe-harbor treaty applies.

india_dpdp_2023.name: India Digital Personal Data Protection Act 2023
india_dpdp_2023.rule: Aadhaar number masking mandatory; outbound AI interactions must provide clear purpose limitation and vernacular consent notice.

south_korea_pipa.name: South Korea Personal Information Protection Act (PIPA)
south_korea_pipa.rule: Resident Registration Numbers (RRN) must be encrypted/omitted; prior affirmative consent required for any cross-border cloud processing.

australia_pspf_data_airlock.name: Australian Protective Security Policy Framework (PSPF) & Data61 Airlock
australia_pspf_data_airlock.rule: Data airlock gate must sanitize SECRET and PROTECTED entity markers prior to leaving the local sovereign perimeter.
